serial.unsupported: Web Serial unavailable — use manual trigger

save.error: Save failed — check that you are signed in

dryFire.manualHint: While armed: Space / Enter or manual trigger — hits accumulate

safety.title: Safety confirmation
safety.subtitle: Confirm all three items before starting dry-fire training.

safety.lockHint: Confirm all three items before starting. Cancel returns you to mode selection.

items.magazine: Magazine removed — no live ammunition in the firearm
items.muzzle: Muzzle pointed in a safe direction — clear backstop

prep.title: Rack the slide
prep.body: Cycle the slide to set the firearm. Rack sounds in this phase are not scored as shots.
prep.rackHeard: Rack sound detected (ignored). Confirm when ready.
prep.armLocked: In fullscreen, tap Beep & Start, rack the slide, then press READY.

steps.one: Keep the muzzle in a safe direction
steps.two: Fully cycle the slide to chamber / set
steps.three: Press READY when done — the session starts

cycle.shotBody: The next trigger press is scored. After a shot, the rack sound is filtered automatically.
cycle.rackBody: Cycle the slide. This sound is not scored; then back to shot (Trigger → Rack).

target.hint: Calibration point stays hidden — only hits are shown

sessionDash.title: Session dashboard
sessionDash.heatmapHint: Heatmap coming soon — shot positions will cluster here.

fullscreen.escHint: Press ESC or the Exit button (top-right) to leave fullscreen
fullscreen.unsupported: Fullscreen is not supported or was blocked by the browser

protocol.title: Fullscreen protocol
protocol.body: Tactical Timer operations run in fullscreen only. Settings, arming, and session controls stay locked until then.
protocol.reentryBody: Fullscreen was left during a session. Operations were stopped — re-enter fullscreen to continue.
protocol.hint: Mandatory safety protocol · leaving fullscreen aborts the session

rings.hint: Ring diameters are physical paper sizes (X=5 cm, 10=10 cm, 9=20 cm…). Distance scale shrinks the face; cm values stay fixed.
rings.hintLive: On-screen equivalent diameters at {{dist}} m (live from scale matrix). Subline is paper reference.
rings.screenFace: On this screen, paper face ≈ {{cm}} cm

analytics.modalHint: Records keep collecting in the background until you Save Session
analytics.empty: Record at least one hit for analysis

history.emptyHint: Use Save Session after shots to archive

shotRec.flinchHigh: Reduce pre-shot movement and preserve trigger surprise.
shotRec.flinchMed: Anticipation before the break — steady breath and wait time.
shotRec.follow: Weak follow-through — hold the sight picture after the break.
shotRec.hold: Hold stability is inconsistent — extend the lock-in.
shotRec.trace: Noisy aim path — tighten the path before the shot.
shotRec.default: Solid fundamentals — drill the weak link deliberately.

hold.tipIdle: Aim while connected; RMS and quality update here.
hold.tipLoose: RMS {{rms}}° / Std {{std}}° — tighten wrist/shoulder lock and improve breath control.
hold.tipFair: RMS {{rms}}° — use a short breath hold and isolate the trigger finger.
hold.tipStable: RMS {{rms}}° — solid lock; keep trigger tempo consistent.
hold.tipElite: RMS {{rms}}° — very low wobble; make this your session standard.

trace.tipIdle: The live path fills as you move the aim.
trace.tipWide: Peak {{peak}}° / radius {{radius}}° — shorten the aim path to tighten the group.
trace.tipDrift: Avg {{avg}}° — reduce off-target drift; balance shoulder pressure.
trace.tipTight: Avg {{avg}}° — compact path; keep repeating the same procedure.

shot.tipIdle: A pre/post window is captured when the trigger breaks.
shot.tipCapturing: Sampling 100 ms after break — keep the firearm still.
shot.tipPartial: Pre {{pre}} / Post {{post}} — check link and sampling for a full window.
shot.tipFlinchHold: Settle fault on the break observed — increase breath control and keep trigger surprise.
shot.tipBreath: Mild wobble at break — equalize breath pause and trigger speed.
shot.tipClean: Pre/post profile looks clean — repeat the same cadence.

session.tipIdle: Trends and tips update after the first shot.
session.tipInconsistent: Consistency {{consistency}} — standardize tempo and aim lock (avg {{avg}}).
session.tipLow: Avg {{avg}} ({{grade}}) — return to hold and flinch drills.
session.tipBuilding: {{n}} shots · avg {{avg}} — keep targeting the weakest metric.

group.tipIdle: Log at least one hit for radar and dispersion.
group.tipOpen: Flinch {{flinch}} · radius {{radius}} — soften trigger press and extend aim lock.
group.tipModerate: Flinch {{flinch}} — watch directional bias on the radar.
group.tipTight: {{n}} hits — group is tight; keep the same procedure.
